repos.name: Star tracker
repos.role: Lost-in-space star identification and star-field sensor simulator (C++), plus a Python centroid/feature pipeline

setup.label: Fetch Python deps for the centroid pipeline
run: import numpy, cv2; print('numpy', numpy.__version__, 'cv2', cv2.__version__)

test.label: Create the gitignored build dir
Build the simulator with the host C++ compiler
Render a synthetic star field (writes out/test_starfield.png)
Python centroid and feature extraction smoke test
run:
import numpy as np, catalog_parse, tumble, synthesize_image, process_centroids, centroids, feature_extraction
img = np.zeros((64, 64), np.uint16)
stars = [(12, 10), (30, 40), (50, 20), (8, 50)]
for x, y in stars: img[y-1:y+2, x-1:x+2] = 1000
cs = centroids.extract_centroids(img, 50.0)
pts = sorted((round(s.x), round(s.y)) for s in cs)
assert pts == sorted(stars), pts
ang, nbr = feature_extraction.extract_features([(s.x, s.y) for s in cs], 2, 0.5, 1.0, 64, 64)
assert ang.shape == (4, 2) and (ang > 0).all(), ang
print('centroids', pts, 'features', ang.shape)

repos.name: SLIP OBC firmware
repos.role: STM32H743 FreeRTOS on-board computer: sensors, GPS, OV5640 cameras, flash/SD logging, CC1201 TTC link

setup.label: fetch STM32CubeH7 v1.12.1 HAL, CMSIS, FreeRTOS, FatFs (cached in uvsd/.deps)
run:
set -euo pipefail
C="${UVSD_CACHE:-$HOME/.cache/uvsd}/stm32cubeh7-v1.12.1"
if [ -f "$C/.done" ]; then echo "STM32CubeH7 v1.12.1 parts already in $C"; exit 0; fi
rm -rf "$C.tmp"; mkdir -p "$C.tmp"
get() { mkdir -p "$C.tmp/$2"; git -C "$C.tmp/$2" init -q; git -C "$C.tmp/$2" fetch -q --depth 1 "https://github.com/STMicroelectronics/$1.git" "$3"; git -C "$C.tmp/$2" -c advice.detachedHead=false checkout -q FETCH_HEAD; rm -rf "$C.tmp/$2/.git"; }
get stm32h7xx_hal_driver Drivers/STM32H7xx_HAL_Driver 57ed86b4c358e2333a71fd895b17f1ccdb68739e
get cmsis_device_h7 Drivers/CMSIS/Device/ST/STM32H7xx e8d40ae6e2fa06afe5b46d24756f141b363342a7
get stm32h7xx-nucleo-bsp Drivers/BSP/STM32H7xx_Nucleo 9f1a34f3af4d7a02da939c094131a90833be4a0c
git clone -q --filter=blob:none --no-checkout --depth 1 -b v1.12.1 https://github.com/STMicroelectronics/STM32CubeH7.git "$C.tmp/cube" 2>/dev/null
git -C "$C.tmp/cube" sparse-checkout set --no-cone /Drivers/CMSIS/Include/ /Middlewares/Third_Party/FreeRTOS/Source/ /Middlewares/Third_Party/FatFs/src/
git -C "$C.tmp/cube" -c advice.detachedHead=false checkout -q
mv "$C.tmp/cube/Drivers/CMSIS/Include" "$C.tmp/Drivers/CMSIS/Include"
mkdir -p "$C.tmp/Middlewares/Third_Party"; mv "$C.tmp/cube/Middlewares/Third_Party/FreeRTOS" "$C.tmp/cube/Middlewares/Third_Party/FatFs" "$C.tmp/Middlewares/Third_Party/"
rm -rf "$C.tmp/cube"; touch "$C.tmp/.done"; rm -rf "$C"; mv "$C.tmp" "$C"
echo "STM32CubeH7 v1.12.1 parts fetched into $C"

test.label: STM32H743 firmware compiles (arm-none-eabi-gcc -c, no link)
run:
set -euo pipefail
C="${UVSD_CACHE:-$HOME/.cache/uvsd}/stm32cubeh7-v1.12.1"; [ -f "$C/.done" ] || { echo "STM32CubeH7 v1.12.1 parts missing in $C: run setup"; exit 1; }
cd project; R=$C/Middlewares/Third_Party/FreeRTOS/Source; F=$C/Middlewares/Third_Party/FatFs/src
FL="-mcpu=cortex-m7 -mfpu=fpv5-d16 -mfloat-abi=hard -mthumb"
CF="$FL -std=gnu11 -O0 -Wall -fpermissive -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -DDEBUG -DUSE_HAL_DRIVER -DSTM32H743xx -ICore/Inc -IFATFS/App -IFATFS/Target -I$C/Drivers/STM32H7xx_HAL_Driver/Inc -I$C/Drivers/STM32H7xx_HAL_Driver/Inc/Legacy -I$C/Drivers/CMSIS/Device/ST/STM32H7xx/Include -I$C/Drivers/CMSIS/Include -I$R/include -I$R/CMSIS_RTOS_V2 -I$R/portable/GCC/ARM_CM4F -I$F"
n=0; for s in Core/Src/*.c FATFS/App/*.c FATFS/Target/*.c $(ls $C/Drivers/STM32H7xx_HAL_Driver/Src/*.c | grep -v _template) $R/croutine.c $R/event_groups.c $R/list.c $R/queue.c $R/stream_buffer.c $R/tasks.c $R/timers.c $R/CMSIS_RTOS_V2/cmsis_os2.c $R/portable/MemMang/heap_4.c $R/portable/GCC/ARM_CM4F/port.c $F/diskio.c $F/ff.c $F/ff_gen_drv.c $F/option/syscall.c; do arm-none-eabi-gcc $CF -c "$s" -o /dev/null; n=$((n+1)); done
arm-none-eabi-gcc $FL -c -x assembler-with-cpp Core/Startup/startup_stm32h743zitx.s -o /dev/null
echo "compiled $n C files + startup for STM32H743 (no link)"

test.label: STM32H743 firmware build + link (arm-none-eabi-gcc)
run:
set -euo pipefail
C="${UVSD_CACHE:-$HOME/.cache/uvsd}/stm32cubeh7-v1.12.1"; [ -f "$C/.done" ] || { echo "STM32CubeH7 v1.12.1 parts missing in $C: run setup"; exit 1; }
O=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$O"' EXIT; cd STM_to_CC1201
FL="-mcpu=cortex-m7 -mfpu=fpv5-d16 -mfloat-abi=hard -mthumb"
CF="$FL -std=gnu11 -O0 -Wall -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -DDEBUG -DUSE_PWR_LDO_SUPPLY -DUSE_NUCLEO_64 -DUSE_HAL_DRIVER -DSTM32H743xx -ICore/Inc -I$C/Drivers/STM32H7xx_HAL_Driver/Inc -I$C/Drivers/STM32H7xx_HAL_Driver/Inc/Legacy -I$C/Drivers/BSP/STM32H7xx_Nucleo -I$C/Drivers/CMSIS/Device/ST/STM32H7xx/Include -I$C/Drivers/CMSIS/Include"
n=0; for s in Core/Src/*.c $C/Drivers/BSP/STM32H7xx_Nucleo/stm32h7xx_nucleo.c $(ls $C/Drivers/STM32H7xx_HAL_Driver/Src/*.c | grep -v _template); do n=$((n+1)); arm-none-eabi-gcc $CF -c "$s" -o "$O/$n.o"; done
arm-none-eabi-gcc $FL -c -x assembler-with-cpp Core/Startup/startup_stm32h743zitx.s -o "$O/startup.o"
arm-none-eabi-gcc $FL "$O"/*.o -TSTM32H743ZITX_FLASH.ld --specs=nosys.specs --specs=nano.specs -Wl,--gc-sections -static -Wl,--start-group -lc -lm -Wl,--end-group -o "$O/STM_to_CC1201.elf"
arm-none-eabi-size "$O/STM_to_CC1201.elf"
